recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration (a) review the documentation and processes related to approval of transfer of funds raised through the Crisis Relief website for country-based pool funds to any other specially designated contributions project from individual and private donations and (b) amend the agreement between the United Nations Foundation and the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs to clearly stipulate that a portion of funds raised through the Crisis Relief platform will be used to cover operational and management costs.
